desc: Read input N, M, A, B and the M intervals. Store intervals in a sorted list.
Generate a set of critical points: include 1 and N. For each interval $[L_i, R_i]$, add $L_i - 1$ and $R_i + 1$ if they are in $[1, N]$.
Sort and unique the critical points. Remove any that are bad (covered by any interval).
Build an adjacency list for the critical points: for each critical point u, find all critical points v such that $v - u \in [A, B]$.
Run BFS/DFS from node 1 to see if node N is reachable.
Print "Yes" if N is reachable, "No" otherwise.
